notes: Tumski Bridge exterior: two open low lattice side girders, curved upper side chords and vertical hangers, one curved central overhead lattice portal, two open river spans over a cutwater pier, skewed bank bearings, separate outer walks, slim railings, two robed stone entrance statues on pedestals and paired gas lamps. Fixed 110 m datum and approximate 113.8 m deck. Standard terrain samples 110.150 m review water. Sculptures, steel sections, deck elevation and buried foundations are ordinary-photo approximations.
